title: Vase with Names of Amenhotep III and Queen Tiye
acquisition: Inscription metadata from official Walters art.csv export. Image from Walters donation to Wikimedia Commons. Longer artwork descriptions excluded.
text: Perfect god, Neb-maat-Re, son of Re, Amenhotep-Ruler of Thebes, may he live like Re; Royal wife, Tiye, may she live.
original_inscription_field: [Translation] Perfect god, Neb-maat-Re, son of Re, Amenhotep-Ruler of Thebes, may he live like Re; Royal wife, Tiye, may she live.
geography: Current museum page identifies Egypt as place of discovery; older Commons metadata says Attica, Greece. Current primary attribution retained; discrepancy unresolved. No precise findspot.
provenance: Rev. William MacGregor, Tamworth, Staffordshire, by 1922; Sale, Sotheby, Wilkinson & Hodge, London, June 26-29 and July 4-6, 1922, no. 272; Dikran Kelekian, Paris and New York, 1922, by purchase; Henry Walters, Baltimore, 1923, by purchase; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
coverage_evidence: Museum renders both royal names, titles and life wishes on the vase.
visual_observation: Full blue faience vase shown; rectangular panel with three cartouches visible. Pale text on blue glaze, glare and chipped glaze; one viewpoint.
rights_scope: Inscription metadata CC0 under current museum policy; photograph reused under explicit Commons file-page CC BY-SA 3.0 terms. Longer GFDL descriptions excluded.

image_rights_evidence.creator: The Walters Art Museum
